decision_rows.action: Claims should be submitted by June 30 for expenses that were incurred in the previous calendar year. Claims filed after June 30 of the following year will not be reimbursed. For INN: 90 days from the date of service (DOS). Process claims according to Group step guidelines and proceed to Step 10.

NALC members may submit claims through December 31st of the year following the year in which the service was rendered (i.e., if service date is 4/1/2020, the member can submit the claim through 12/31/2021). OON providers – 15 months from the date of service. INN providers – 90 days from the date of service to submit a claim (DOS). Process claims according to Group step guidelines and proceed to Step 10.
